title: [Shopify] Add Transactions navigation action to Shopify Refund page
summary: The Shopify Refund page now includes a Transactions navigation action that displays payment transactions linked to a specific refund, matching the functionality already available on the Shopify Order page.
key_points: Added Transactions action to the Shopify Refund page navigation area
Opens Shpfy Order Transactions filtered by Refund Id
Provides feature parity with the Shopify Order page
Uses existing Refund Id field connection in transaction data
